description: Cardiology case. Exercises mutual-exclusion arbitration on the EKG cluster, the § 5 Abs. 4 lab band, and a justification bound to one line only.

blocked_ziffern.note: Nr. 650-653 are mutually exclusive per the official Anmerkung. Nr. 651 has the stronger evidence (1.0 vs 0.70) even though Nr. 650 is worth fewer points either way.

factor_expectations.note: 'mittel' justification bound to the consultation only
Abschnitt M: § 5 Abs. 4 band. The justification on the consultation must NOT leak here.
The official text contains no exclusion between Nr. 659 and the Nr. 650-653 cluster, so the Langzeit-EKG is chargeable alongside. No rule was invented to make it look tidier.
